Apply restrained matte pigment areas to Image 1 only, retain fine charcoal outlines, slight texture only within solid forms. Entire exterior background, empty sky and true openings should be perfectly flat opaque PURE WHITE #FFFFFF or native transparency if returned. No black background, haze, gradient, paper texture, glow, cast shadow, checkerboard, people, labels, extra buildings, invented garden features, frame or watermark. This is colorization, not redesign.
